title: Remora (fr.igitscor.remora)
description: Remora's managed settings. Generated by scripts/make-policy-files.py.

AllowedPlugins.title: Allowed tools
AllowedPlugins.description: The tools that may be connected and refreshed, by plugin ID: github, gitlab, bitbucket, azuredevops, slack, linear, jira, notion, microsoft, claude-code, claude, openai. Any other is refused.

AllowExternalAI.title: Allow external AI
AllowExternalAI.description: Allow the assistant to send inbox content off the computer: to Anthropic for Claude, to the configured server for OpenAI-compatible.

AllowRemoteImages.title: Allow avatars
AllowRemoteImages.description: Load avatars, from the hosts of allowed tools only.

AIExcludedSources.title: Tools kept from the assistant
AIExcludedSources.description: Tools whose items never reach the assistant (brief, summaries, triage); reminders for the user's own reminders. Added to the user's choice.

AllowedAIModels.title: Allowed AI models
AllowedAIModels.description: The models the assistant may use, by any provider's IDs. A model not listed is replaced by the first one.

AllowedAIServers.title: Allowed AI servers
AllowedAIServers.description: The servers the OpenAI-compatible assistant may use, as URL prefixes (scheme, host, port and path).

AIServer.title: AI server
AIServer.description: The server the OpenAI-compatible assistant uses, filled in and locked in Settings.

AllowLocalAI.title: Allow an AI server on this computer
AllowLocalAI.description: A server on this computer (localhost): allowed even with external AI off, or refused.

AllowLocalAPI.title: Allow scripts and agents to read the inbox
AllowLocalAPI.description: The remora command and the MCP server for AI agents on this computer (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Gemini CLI). Off: nothing on the computer can read the inbox but the app.

AIDailyLimit.title: Assistant requests a day
AIDailyLimit.description: The most requests the assistant may send each day (a brief, a summary or a triage is one), from 1 to 10000. Past it, the assistant waits until the next day. Locked in Settings.

HiddenContentSources.title: Hide message content
HiddenContentSources.description: Tools whose notifications say where something happened, not what was written; reminders for the user's own reminders. Added to the user's choice.

RefreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval
RefreshMinutes.description: How often tools are checked, from 1 to 60 minutes. Locked in Settings.

OpenInApps.title: Open in desktop apps
OpenInApps.description: Open Slack and Linear items in their desktop app when installed; disabled always opens the web page.

ClaudeCodePath.title: Claude Code path
ClaudeCodePath.description: The claude program Remora runs, instead of the one found or entered. It must still be named claude and pass Remora's checks.

MicrosoftTenant.title: Microsoft 365 tenant
MicrosoftTenant.description: The organization's Microsoft Entra tenant, by domain or ID, for signing in to Microsoft 365. Filled in and locked in the connect form.

MicrosoftClientID.title: Microsoft 365 client ID
MicrosoftClientID.description: The application (client) ID of the app the organization registered in Microsoft Entra for Remora. Filled in and locked in the connect form.

AutomaticUpdates.title: Automatic updates
AutomaticUpdates.description: Enabled: check for a new version once a day, locked on. Disabled: no update check at all.
